secondary_checks.diversity_note: Proxy for the preregistered anion / light-element group check: number of distinct element families (unique element sets) among the top-5% hits each arm found. Declared deviation.

pairing_check.method: Each seed draws one initial labeled set; the hash of every arm's starting set is compared with it.

caveat: Retrospective benchmark: labels were precomputed by DFPT and revealed by a simulated oracle. Not a prospective discovery.
